notes: Average GROSS monthly wage in the Sofia-city statistical region (BG411), as published by НСИ and unmodified. `value` and `ref_period` are НСИ's latest published QUARTERLY average (1915 EUR at 2026-Q1 (preliminary)); `series_by_period` is their full quarterly series from the `{year}trimes` sheets of Labour_1.1.2.2_EUR_EN.xlsx. Nothing in this file is computed by us. The quarter is НСИ's own reporting period and avoids the March bonus spike that dominates their single-month readings; the Q4 column taken is `IV`, not `IV incl.annual bonuses`. Sofia province (excl. city) at the same quarter: 1294 EUR — Sofia-city is structurally higher and is the highest-wage region in BG. All values in EUR (fixed 1.95583 BGN/EUR).
disclaimer: Sofia-city is a single statistical region (BG411). The number is the average GROSS wage across all employees on a labour contract or in the civil service in the region (not net; not specific to any industry or occupation), reported for НСИ's own quarter. The Q4 figure excludes annual bonuses, which НСИ publish as a separate column. EUR figures from NSI use the fixed eurozone rate 1.95583 BGN/EUR — no FX adjustment over time. Landing page: https://www.nsi.bg/en/statistical-data/179/569
